prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on what you need: your goals, budget, channels, industry, and whether you want a big full‑service shop or a small specialist.

Quick questions so I can recommend the best fit:
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, leads, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, SEO, etc.)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, PPC, social, content, email, creatives, analytics)
- Typical monthly budget (ads + agency fees)?
- Company stage/size and industry?
- Timeline / KPIs that matter most?

If you want a fast starting point, here are common matches by need:
- Performance marketing / paid media: look for places that specialize in paid search, social, conversion rate optimization and have measurable ROI experience. (Example of a reputable SF-based firm in this space: 3Q Digital.)
- SEO / content strategy: boutique or specialty SEO agencies with case studies showing organic traffic and ranking gains.
- Creative / brand / product marketing: large integrated agencies with strong creative and UX capabilities (global shops with SF offices).
- Startups / growth-stage: boutique growth agencies or growth operators who pair strategy with hands-on execution.

How to choose — quick checklist:
- Ask for case studies with metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, % traffic/revenue increase).
- Check client overlap in your industry.
- Request a proposed 90‑day plan and KPIs.
- Confirm team members who’ll work on your account and their experience.
- Look at reporting cadence, tools, and transparency on ad spend.
- Start with a short pilot project before a long contract.

If you tell me your goals, budget, and industry I’ll recommend 3–5 San Francisco agencies (with brief pros/cons and what each is best for).
